"""Synthetic exploratory materials; not human-validated or a confirmatory set."""

from __future__ import annotations


def garden_paths() -> list[dict]:
    families = [
        ("washed", "mother", "baby", "sleeping", "father"),
        ("dressed", "parent", "child", "smiling", "nanny"),
        ("hunted", "hunter", "deer", "running", "ranger"),
        ("watched", "guard", "prisoner", "waiting", "officer"),
        ("visited", "doctor", "patient", "resting", "nurse"),
        ("called", "teacher", "student", "listening", "principal"),
        ("trained", "coach", "athlete", "stretching", "instructor"),
        ("read", "editor", "report", "missing", "author"),
    ]
    return [
        {
            "id": verb,
            "family": verb,
            "ambiguous": f"While the {actor} {verb} the {target}",
            "clean": f"While the {actor} {verb}, the {target}",
            "lexical_ambiguous": f"While the {other} {verb} the {target}",
            "lexical_clean": f"While the {other} {verb}, the {target}",
            "critical": "was",
            "spillover": spillover,
        }
        for verb, actor, target, spillover, other in families
    ]


def role_items() -> list[dict]:
    """Subject/non-subject and agent/patient crossed with voice and target order.

    Decoding happens at a target cue AFTER the full sentence. It is explicitly
    a retrospective readout, not evidence of incremental role assignment.
    Fronted forms are evaluation-only structural transfer diagnostics.
    """
    families = [
        ("greeted", (("teacher", "nurse"), ("farmer", "baker"))),
        ("helped", (("doctor", "guard"), ("pilot", "sailor"))),
        ("followed", (("lawyer", "artist"), ("driver", "clerk"))),
        ("thanked", (("chef", "singer"), ("dancer", "painter"))),
        ("visited", (("student", "tailor"), ("actor", "barber"))),
        ("photographed", (("dentist", "soldier"), ("writer", "plumber"))),
        ("invited", (("judge", "waiter"), ("editor", "carpenter"))),
        ("praised", (("coach", "priest"), ("mayor", "mechanic"))),
    ]
    rows = []
    for i, (verb, pairs) in enumerate(families):
        split = "train" if i < 4 else "test"
        for pair_index, (agent, patient) in enumerate(pairs):
            forms = [
                ("active", f"The {agent} {verb} the {patient}.", agent, agent),
                ("passive", f"The {patient} was {verb} by the {agent}.", patient, patient),
            ]
            if split == "test":
                forms += [
                    ("object_fronted", f"The {patient}, the {agent} {verb}.", agent, patient),
                    ("agent_fronted", f"By the {agent}, the {patient} was {verb}.", patient, agent),
                ]
            for form, sentence, subject, first in forms:
                for target in (agent, patient):
                    rows.append(
                        {
                            "id": f"{verb}-{pair_index}-{form}-{target}",
                            "family": verb,
                            "split": split,
                            "construction": form,
                            "sentence": sentence,
                            "target": target,
                            "subject": int(target == subject),
                            "agent": int(target == agent),
                            "first_mention": int(target == first),
                            "prompt": sentence + f"\nTarget: the {target}",
                        }
                    )
    return rows
modal_app.py:
"""Run one bounded A10G pilot, uploading only the v2 Python source allowlist."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import modal

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
app = modal.App("garden-path-v2")
cache = modal.Volume.from_name("gps-hf-cache", create_if_missing=True)
results = modal.Volume.from_name("gps-v2-results", create_if_missing=True)
image = (
    modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.11")
    .pip_install("torch==2.10.0", "transformers==5.9.0", "numpy==2.4.3", "sentencepiece==0.2.1")
    .env({"HF_HOME": "/cache/hf", "PYTHONPATH": "/app"})
)
for name in ("__init__.py", "materials.py", "experiment.py", "modal_app.py"):
    image = image.add_local_file(ROOT / name, f"/app/v2/{name}")


@app.function(
    image=image,
    gpu="A10G",
    timeout=1800,
    retries=0,
    max_containers=1,
    volumes={"/cache/hf": cache, "/results": results},
    secrets=[modal.Secret.from_name("huggingface")],
)
def pilot(run_id: str, revision: str = "") -> dict[str, bytes]:
    from huggingface_hub import HfApi

    from v2.experiment import run

    revision = revision or HfApi().model_info("google/gemma-3-1b-pt").sha
    destination = Path("/results") / run_id
    try:
        run(str(destination), revision)
    finally:
        cache.commit()
        results.commit()
    return {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in destination.iterdir() if p.is_file()}


@app.function(image=image, volumes={"/results": results}, timeout=120)
def collect(run_id: str) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    return {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in (Path("/results") / run_id).iterdir() if p.is_file()}


def save(run_id: str, files: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
    destination = ROOT / "results" / run_id
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, data in files.items():
        path = destination / name
        if path.exists() and path.read_bytes() != data:
            raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite different result: {path}")
        path.write_bytes(data)
    print(f"Saved {len(files)} artifacts to {destination}")


@app.local_entrypoint()
def main(run_id: str = "", fetch: bool = False, revision: str = "") -> None:
    import datetime
    import re

    run_id = run_id or datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", run_id):
        raise ValueError("run-id must contain only letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens")
    save(run_id, collect.remote(run_id) if fetch else pilot.remote(run_id, revision))
